title: FEEL THE DROP EDM Entity Style Guide (KO-EN-JA)
scope: EDM and electronic-music artists, festivals, clubs/venues, labels, and genres

usage_policy.priority: For matching entities, this file is the preferred FEEL THE DROP house-style authority.
usage_policy.english: Preserve the exact capitalization, spacing, punctuation, accents, and symbols in `en`.
usage_policy.korean: Use `ko` as the preferred Korean output. Values in `aliases.ko` are for input recognition only.
usage_policy.japanese: In Japanese social copy, use `ja_display` by default. Use `ja_reading` only when a pronunciation aid or katakana rendering is needed.
usage_policy.aliases: Aliases are accepted input variants; do not automatically use them as output.
usage_policy.avoid: Do not output values in `avoid` unless quoting an error or explaining a correction.
usage_policy.unknown_entity: For entities not in this file, preserve the official Latin spelling and do not invent a Korean or Japanese transliteration.
usage_policy.conflicts: If the user explicitly requests a different spelling, follow the user and briefly flag the house-style conflict only when useful.
usage_policy.editorial_note: Korean and Japanese transliterations can vary by outlet. This file defines FEEL THE DROP's preferred editorial style rather than claiming a single universally mandatory spelling.
